title: Compare-prompts route has no linked request-level coverage
reasoning: The new network-exposed compare-prompts endpoint is wired directly in hub/urls.py, but none of the included tests exercise this route, its URL name, status codes, serialization shape, missing reading behavior, or authorization expectations. Because the route accepts user-controlled reading_id and is labeled as an admin endpoint, regressions in access control or API contract could ship without failing the linked test set.
recommendation: Add focused tests that reverse or call hub_reading_compare_prompts for an existing reading and a missing reading, and assert the intended authentication/permission behavior and response schema.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included tests cover Armenian text scraping, Bible API tasks, devotional listing, email behavior, fast views, and feast admin icon actions, but they do not call or reverse hub_reading_compare_prompts.
suggestedRegressionTest: Create a test module or extend an appropriate admin/API test to call reverse('hub_reading_compare_prompts', args=[reading.pk]) and assert success for an authorized user, denial for an unauthorized user if admin-only, and the expected error for an unknown reading_id.
minimumFixScope: Add route-level tests for compare_reading_prompts and its permission/API contract.
